transcript.text: Kalimera Casey! Two days down, and yesterday you hit the collision problem, which is where everyone gets stuck. searched "juggling two ball exchange balls collide fix throw one hand inside other": https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/jTGbKKGqs5EdyYoRc/most-people-can-t-juggle-one-ball https://nowiknow.com/how-to-juggle/ https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cascade_(juggling) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columns_(juggling) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toss_juggling https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multiplex_(juggling) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juggling_pattern https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_(juggling) http://www.joethejuggler.com/Quito/3Ball/3Ball.html https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juggling_robot

Collisions usually come from throwing both balls along the same line. Two fixes:

• Throw each ball to the opposite shoulder, not straight across. The first ball goes up and over. The second one travels underneath it, on a slightly flatter path.
• Make the first throw a bit higher and more deliberate than the second, so they trade places in the air instead of meeting.

Try that for the first few minutes tonight and tell me in the voice note which one helped. Does that make sense?
Hey Casey! Ten minutes in the living room at 6, two-ball exchange. Remember to throw to the opposite shoulder, with the first ball a bit higher. Grab your balls and clear a little space. Ready to go?

transcript.text: Kalimera Casey! Yesterday's crashing balls are today's puzzle. Tonight at 6 in the living room, throw ball 1 to eye level. When it peaks, send ball 2 on a slightly different path, with ball 1 toward the inside and ball 2 a bit in front, so they miss each other. Go slow, one exchange at a time, 10 min, voice note after. You in?
ok I'm in but seriously how do I stop them crashing

searched "juggling balls collide in the air how to fix beginner": https://en.wikibooks.org/wiki/Juggling/Three_Ball_Cascade https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/jTGbKKGqs5EdyYoRc/most-people-can-t-juggle-one-ball https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juggling_ball http://www.scienceofjuggling.com/howtojuggle.html https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toss_juggling https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multiplex_(juggling) https://huggingface.co/datasets/GGINCoder/lol/viewer/default/train?p=91 https://www.walmart.com/ip/76mm-Forest-Green-Acrylic-Contact-Juggling-Ball/994159041 https://www.walmart.com/ip/451866491

Collisions almost always come from the throws, not the catches, Casey. Three fixes:

• Throw in two matching arcs, each peaking at eye level, with the same height every time. Crashes happen when one throw is lower or drifts toward the middle.
• Make ball 1 a true cross-body arc, from your right hand up and over to your left. Ball 2 goes the same way from the other hand. The two arcs should pass each other like an X, not run up the middle.
• Send ball 2 only when ball 1 peaks. Say "throw" out loud at the top.

Start with a few slow exchanges and ignore catching for now. Then send me the voice note after 6 and tell me which fix helped most 💪
Hey Casey! Ten minutes at 6 in the living room, two-ball exchange. Say "throw" out loud when ball 1 peaks, and go slow. Voice note after, and tell me which fix helped most. Ready?

That's the hardest part, Casey, and you showed up for it. We'll work on it tomorrow.

transcript.text: Kalimera Casey! Yesterday the two balls kept crashing, so today we fix the timing. At 6 pm in the living room, throw ball 1 in a low arc to eye level, and send ball 2 only when ball 1 peaks. Aim them side by side, not through the same spot. Ten minutes, then a voice note on how it went. You in?
ok I'm in but seriously how do I stop them crashing

searched "juggling 3 balls two ball exchange balls collide fix throw one hand inside other": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toss_juggling https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Columns_(juggling) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cascade_(juggling) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Multiplex_(juggling) https://www.teesche.com/blog/how_to_juggle_with_three_balls https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juggling_pattern https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box_(juggling) http://www.joethejuggler.com/Quito/3Ball/3Ball.html https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mills%27_Mess https://www.jugglequip.com/post/how-to-juggle-3-balls

Crashes almost always come from two things: both balls aimed at the same spot, or throws drifting forward. Try this:
• Pick two targets, one above each shoulder, and throw every ball to the same spot each time.
• Stand with your elbows at your sides and your hands about a ball-width in front of your belly.
• Throw ball 1 from your right hand up to the left shoulder spot, and throw ball 2 from your left hand when ball 1 peaks. It goes under ball 1, not into it.
• Keep the throws the same height every time. Slow and boring is the goal.

Do your 6 pm run with that, and tell me in the voice note which part still crashes.

Hey Casey! Ten minutes in the living room at 6, two balls, slow throws. Aim each one to its own shoulder spot so they pass side by side. Get set up now, and send me a voice note after on which part still crashes 🎯
